symbols.name: binary field
symbols.meaning: The field with the two elements 0 and 1, in which addition is exclusive or and multiplication is AND.
symbols.quote: The binary field, written $\mathbb{F}_2$, is the field with the two elements $0$ and $1$, where addition is exclusive or ($\oplus$), which gives $1$ exactly when its two bits differ, and multiplication is AND.

symbols.name: exclusive or
symbols.meaning: The addition of the binary field, which gives 1 exactly when its two bits differ.
symbols.quote: The binary field, written $\mathbb{F}_2$, is the field with the two elements $0$ and $1$, where addition is exclusive or ($\oplus$), which gives $1$ exactly when its two bits differ, and multiplication is AND.

symbols.name: three-element subset
symbols.meaning: A three-element subset of the ground set, one of the two whose shared elements give a coefficient.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$ be three-element subsets of the ground set.

symbols.name: second three-element subset
symbols.meaning: A second three-element subset of the ground set, the output side of the coefficient.
symbols.quote: Let $\sigma$ and $\sigma'$ be three-element subsets of the ground set.

relations.quote: The addition of $\mathbb{F}_2$ is defined by [congruence](congruence-modulo.md) modulo $2$.
